text:
maria: FYI rolled v3.1-int4 as 5% canary at 06:10. infra/memory looks stable, p99 latency +2ms. but short_factual MRR down ~3.2% vs control (p=0.003). want consensus on auto-rollback rule before expanding. cc @anika @sam

sam: ouch. do we have raw sample counts and CIs?

maria: control n=12,432, treatment n=12,300. MRR ctrl=0.274 -> trt=0.265. bootstrap diff CI = [-0.012, -0.008]. hallucination rate on that slice +0.5% abs.

anika: thanks. proposal for an automated safety net:
- Preconditions: evaluate only for slices with min_samples >= 5k in the last 15m window.
- Trigger if ANY of: 
  * primary metric (mrr_short_factual) relative delta <= -1.5% AND p <= 0.01, OR
  * absolute drop in primary metric >= 2.0% (any p), OR
  * hallucination abs increase >= 0.3% AND p <= 0.05.
- Hysteresis: require condition to hold for 3 consecutive 15m windows (to avoid flapping).
- Action: automatic rollback to control and create a rollout-audit ticket with telemetry snapshot and sample buckets.

maria: +1. we should also gate rollback for slices that are noisy by default (examples: fewshot longprompt). maybe we keep a whitelist/blacklist per-slice.

ops-bot: draft CLI to create policy:
```
/runtool create-fallback --model v3.1-int4 --policy "mrr_rel:-0.015:p<=0.01|mrr_abs:-0.02|halluc_abs:0.003:p<=0.05" --min-samples 5000 --hysteresis 3x15m --notify #incidents
```

leo: alternative play: drop canary to 1% immediately, run the slice-targeted smoke suite (short_factual fewshot + static prompts) to increase power for that slice without risking broader traffic. if smoke eval corroborates gap we let the automated policy stand.

sam: I like shrinking traffic then run a focused A/B with the smoke harness. also add a requirement that the auto-fallback posts a raw-sample dump to the audit ticket so we can reproduce locally.

anika: small tweak: for hallucination triggers require the metric to be monotonically increasing over the 3 windows (no single-window spike).

maria: ok Im going to reduce to 1% now, spin the smoke eval, and create the fallback policy with id fallback-v3.1int4-2024-06-23. will paste the smoke link once ready and file the audit ticket.

ops-bot: policy created: id=fallback-v3.1int4-2024-06-23. alerting -> #incidents. auto-rollback enabled if conditions met.

leo: thanks. ping when smoke eval finishes so we can decide expand vs revert. :thumbsup:

maria: will report results in this thread.
